question: Which of the following institution has developed a device named "AroTrack"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Bombay**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **AroTrack** is a device developed by researchers and engineers at **IIT Bombay**. It is aimed at tracking and monitoring air quality. 
• This device helps in real-time monitoring of **air pollution levels** and provides critical data for addressing environmental concerns effectively. 
• The primary focus of AroTrack is to measure pollutants like **PM2.5, PM10, NOx, CO, and SO2**, which are hazardous to human health and the environment. 
• IIT Bombay, located in Powai, Mumbai, is one of India's premier institutions for engineering and technology and has been at the forefront of research in environmental monitoring systems. 
• The development of AroTrack aligns with India's commitment to improving air quality under various international accords and national policies like the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **IIT Bombay:** 
• Established in **1958**, IIT Bombay is recognized as one of the leading institutions for engineering and technology education and research in India. 
• It is known for its contributions to innovative research in fields like **environmental engineering, artificial intelligence, and renewable energy.** 
• Located in Powai, Mumbai, IIT Bombay has collaborated with several industries and government bodies for the development of advanced technologies. 
• **Air Pollution in India:** 
• India faces significant challenges with **air pollution**, with cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata frequently ranking among the most polluted globally. 
• The main pollutants include **particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10), nitrogen oxides (NOx), sulfur dioxide (SO2), carbon monoxide (CO), and ozone (O3)**. 
• The government has implemented measures like the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** to tackle air pollution by setting targets for reducing PM2.5 and PM10 levels. 
• **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP):** 
• Launched in **2019**, NCAP aims to reduce particulate matter pollution by **20-30%** by 2024 (from 2017 levels). 
• The program focuses on 122 cities identified as non-attainment cities, where pollution levels have consistently exceeded permissible limits. 
• It encourages the use of technology, research, and public awareness to address air quality concerns. 
• **Features of AroTrack:** 
• AroTrack is compact, portable, and capable of providing **real-time data** on air quality. 
• The device integrates with **smartphone applications** and cloud-based systems to ensure data accessibility and visualization. 
• It is designed for use by urban planners, environmental agencies, and researchers to monitor and mitigate pollution. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Comparison of Options:** 
• **IIT Bombay:** Known for advanced research in technology and environmental monitoring. Correct answer. 
• **IISC Bangalore:** Renowned for research in science and engineering, but no specific mention of AroTrack development. 
• **IIT Kanpur:** Focuses on environmental and air quality research but not associated with AroTrack. 
• **IIT Roorkee:** Known for research in water resources and environmental engineering but not linked to AroTrack. 
• **Key Statistics on Air Pollution:** 
• As per the **World Health Organization (WHO)**, air pollution is responsible for over **7 million deaths** annually worldwide. 
• In India, it is estimated that more than **1.67 million deaths** were attributable to air pollution in **2019**. 
• Devices like AroTrack play a crucial role in monitoring and addressing these concerns. </ul
